# Run Task

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `command.task.run.command` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/command.yaml` |
| Tags | command |

Invoke a task definition by id, passing an optional arguments mapping.
Wired as `localfabric task run <task_id>` on the CLI and as
POST /v1/task/run on the API surface (Phase C3).
